meta.title: Ultra-Luxury Chalet in Méribel, 3 Valleys — Chalet Yolo
meta.description: 350 m² over five levels with a lift: six bedrooms including four suites, heated indoor pool, spa, home cinema and yoga room in Méribel, Les 3 Vallées.

hero.title: 350 m² of wood, stone and silence.
hero.subtitle: Ultra-Luxury Chalet · Les 3 Vallées

location.title: Location
location.complex: Part of the Chalets Célénia development

pool.text: Heated and entirely private, the indoor pool welcomes morning lengths and evening unwinding alike, after a day on the 600 km of slopes of Les 3 Vallées.

wellness.title: Spa and wellness area
wellness.text: Sauna, hammam, Jacuzzi and Jacuzzi bath: a complete spa, all to yourselves. The perfect setting for an in-chalet massage, bookable à la carte.

cinema.text: A private cinema room for the latest release, a mountain classic or the memories of the day.

yoga.text: Stretch before the first lift of the morning, release the tension after the last run: a room dedicated to yoga, in peace and quiet, without leaving the chalet.

living.title: Living room and kitchen
living.text: On the 4th level, the cathedral-ceiling living room brings together a fireplace, a large dining table and a fitted kitchen: double oven, wine cellar, Nespresso. The chef's playground, and the heart of the chalet.

games.text: A games room to make the evenings last, with friends or family.
